def full_state():
    seg=current_frame.segmentation
    objs=[]
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        b=n['boundary']
        r0=min(p[0] for p in b); r1=max(p[0] for p in b)
        c0=min(p[1] for p in b); c1=max(p[1] for p in b)
        objs.append((n['color'],r0,r1,c0,c1,n['pixels']))
    return sorted(objs)

sb=set(before); sa=set(after)
